signed_rows.behavior: In an empty repository, kmctl init creates docs/README.md, .okf/index.md, .okf/log.md and .okf/manifesto.md, and prints each path it created.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of the four files is missing after the run, or a created path is not printed

signed_rows.behavior: A second kmctl init changes nothing and reports nothing created.
signed_rows.fails_when: any file's content or mtime differs after the second run, or the second run reports a created path

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl init never overwrites a file that already exists.
signed_rows.fails_when: a pre-existing docs/README.md or .okf/manifesto.md has different content after the run

signed_rows.behavior: The bundle kmctl init creates passes the pinned okf validator in strict mode.
signed_rows.fails_when: tests/vendor/okf_validate.py --strict exits nonzero on the created .okf/

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl init creates no Diataxis folders and no .okf/ section folders.
signed_rows.fails_when: any directory exists under docs/ or .okf/ after the run

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl init --json prints one JSON object listing created and skipped paths.
signed_rows.fails_when: stdout is not one JSON object with created and skipped lists
